items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-15
items.q: I, I had a hard time getting to talk to the guy.

ctx.x: I guess Wilbur must have known him pretty well.

Yeah, yeah, Wilbur was taking lessons from him, and quite friendly with him. But I, I think he was kind of a reserved guy. When he talked, it was a slow, warm way of talking. But, uh, it was, I, it was just hard. I, I had a hard time getting to talk to the guy. Mm-hmm.
